description:
Make execution_engine a real core setting and move Polars onto it, so there is one control for the Polars collect engine and no platform-specific `engine` key.

Work:
1. Config and surfaces (one core implementation per adr-one-engine-scoped-surfaces):
   - DatabaseConfig.execution_engine (benchbox/core/schemas.py, beside execution_mode); flows to SQL adapters via get_platform_config and to DataFrame adapters through an explicit get_adapter(..., execution_engine=...) in cli/orchestrator.py (~:321-341; DataFrame adapters only receive registered option names today).
   - CLI flag --execution-engine on benchbox run (benchbox/cli/commands/run.py, advanced options near --mode), validated after the platform is resolved by core resolve_requested.
   - MCP: execution_engine parameter on run_benchmark and start_benchmark (benchbox/mcp/tools/benchmark.py, benchbox/mcp/jobs.py), validated by the same core function; one core contract entry with security class execution; remove `engine` from the polars MCP allowlist and contract (mcp/schemas.py:134-135, 228).
   - Adapter construction applies resolve_requested for every platform, so a non-default value on a platform without declared engines fails before any work.
2. Polars DataFrame adapter (benchbox/platforms/dataframe/polars_df.py) and compat (benchbox/platforms/polars_compat.py):
   - Constructor takes execution_engine; remove the `engine` platform option row (platforms/__init__.py:615), COLLECT_ENGINES (manifest is authoritative) and PolarsEngineUnsupportedError (use ExecutionEngineUnavailableError); keep collect_accepts_engine / collect_engine_supported probes and collect_frame as the only collect path.
   - `streaming=true` option, MCP `streaming`, and --polars-streaming become a deprecated alias for execution_engine=streaming with a warning (per ADR D5).
   - DataFrame tuning execution.engine_affinity and streaming_mode map to the requested engine with resolution=tuning_profile, so engine_affinity=in-memory is honored (today it is dropped at polars_df.py:117-120).
   - Conflicting explicit values raise (extend the check at polars_df.py:88-89).
   - `default` is resolved by introspection: the default of LazyFrame.collect's engine parameter, or in-memory when the parameter is absent; applied_native records the literal collect kwargs and POLARS_ENGINE_AFFINITY from pl.Config.state().
   - get_platform_info returns the ExecutionEngineReceipt under execution_engine; drop the ad-hoc engine_requested / collect_engine_argument / observed_execution keys (legacy reader handles old bundles).
3. SQL-mode polars adapter (benchbox/platforms/polars_platform.py) declares no engines and rejects non-default values; its `streaming`/`engine` handling is removed.
4. Anonymizer: delete the Polars `engine` public_option_values exemption (anonymization_specs.yaml:142-152).
5. Polars version-matrix scripts move to --execution-engine and read platform.execution_engine (scripts/run_polars_version_matrix.py, scripts/polars_matrix_spec.py, scripts/analyze_polars_version_matrix.py, tests/fixtures/version_matrix/polars_dry_run.txt); the analyzer still reads the 120 existing bundles through the legacy mapping.
6. Docs: docs/platforms/polars.md, docs/platforms/dataframe.md (incl. the tuning execution section), docs/reference/mcp.md, docs/reference/cli configuration reference, MCP option contract doc.
